body:
Your Questions Shape the Tools at Knit by Machine

Every time a knitter reaches out with a “Why is this curling?” or “Do I have enough needles?” something important happens behind the scenes — you steer the platform.

Your Questions Are Direction, Not Problems

When you contact me with a challenge, it’s more than troubleshooting — it’s insight. Your questions highlight the exact spots where machine knitters need clarity, shortcuts, or confidence.

I take notes. I watch for patterns. I look for the deeper “why” behind each message. These questions become the seeds of new tools and guidance.

How Your Questions Shape the Platform

  • Wizards: When you ask how to size something, calculate something, or adapt something — that becomes a new wizard.

  • Workshops: When many knitters struggle with the same concept, it moves onto the workshop roadmap.

  • Ask ’n Answer (ANA): Individual questions become permanent, searchable guidance so the next knitter gets the clarity instantly.

WIFM: Why This Matters for You

When you ask a question, you’re not just solving your own issue. You’re improving the entire platform for every machine knitter who follows.

Ask once — and you get answers, plus lasting tools that prevent the issue from happening again.

Your Questions Are Fuel

Knit by Machine grows because of your curiosity and challenges. Questions aren’t interruptions — they’re energy. They move the platform forward, spark new ideas, and help me build exactly what you need next.

So please keep them coming.
